how_to_use: Pick references by type and section: a wireframe or image-map row for wireframe stages, a mockup row for mockup stages, and one real example (a mockup-crop or mockup row) for each non-split treatment named in references/composition-treatments.json.
scripts/composition.py typed_references() does this selection; scripts/stage_executor.py attaches the urls as input_urls and the prompt names each reference by type only.
Rows tagged counter-example-composition show the split default: use them for structure and finish, never as the composition target.

A row with contains_reference_only_text true holds placeholder tokens, a signature or a person's name (see reference_only_text on the row). typed_references() never picks such a row; do not send one to an image model.
media_path is the file's path in the library; sha256 is of the uploaded bytes. Re-verify with a HEAD request and a re-download before a paid run.
gaps: mask-pill is covered only by gen-arch-pill-band; mask-diagonal, card-overlaps-photo, band-over-texture, break-the-frame and section-intersect have no reference row yet (std-hybrid-board, the only diagonal example, carries a signature and is excluded). The prompt rules in composition-treatments.json carry them until a reference is added.
The gen-* rows are HTML renders with illustrated stand-in subjects, not photographs.
url_assembly: Each row stores media_path only. composition.load_catalog() builds the url as <SKILL71_REFERENCE_MEDIA_BASE>/<media_path>. The operator injects that base (the media library's public base URL up to and including its account segment) into the environment of the run, the way other operator-held values are injected. With no base set, no hosted reference is attached and the prompt text still carries the rules. The library's account identifier is never committed in this file.
